metadata.description: Context bundle for Paper Scout multi-agent workflow

direct_match_methodology.description: Paper explicitly uses Bayesian modeling or similar inference framework

conceptual_alignment.description: Paper addresses visual perception, uncertainty, or decision-making

experimental_rigor.description: Rigorous methodology (psychophysical, neuroimaging, or computational validation)

novelty.description: Novel findings, unexpected results, or new theoretical insights

target_collections.name: Paper Scout — Curated (Current)
target_collections.purpose: High-relevance papers from recent discovery runs

target_collections.name: Paper Scout — Methodology
target_collections.purpose: Papers with novel Bayesian or inference methods

curation_report.paper_entry_format: | Title | Authors | DOI | Relevance | Cluster | Summary |

agent_instructions.discovery_agent: Query bioRxiv across all configured categories. Return structured metadata (title, authors, DOI, abstract, publication date) for all matching papers.
agent_instructions.analysis_agent: For each paper: extract key concepts, assess methodology, score relevance using provided rubric. Flag papers with high relevance (>0.7) for priority curation.
agent_instructions.curation_agent: Rank papers by composite score. Identify thematic clusters using keyword matching. Create concise briefs (150–200 words) highlighting methodology, key findings, and CSNL relevance.
agent_instructions.integration_agent: Write high-relevance papers to Zotero target collections. Add tags and annotation notes. Generate final team report with stats and recommendations.
